integrity: The proof includes an exhaustive rational 64-pattern arrangement calculation and a separate analytic derivative argument. The included verifier was run. Numerical samples serve only as corroboration; independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Haar-uniform central planes only; right prisms with equilateral base; no claim about offset plane sampling, generic prisms, section area, or angular shape distributions. Historical priority remains provisional because relevant older stereology full texts were inaccessible.
title: Exact Haar section law and unique pentagon-optimal aspect ratio for regular triangular prisms
